decision.title: Phase 5 gate review (packet )
decision.summary: The Phase 5 gate review passes with XSD in scope at 99.9 % and schema-aware XQ40 and XT40 above their gates, adds schema_fuzz, merges XML text helpers, and declares schema.h stable.

body.p: by the review agent (), after , , and . The owner moved the confirming runs to a machine of their own (): the gate boxes that need full suite runs or fuzzing stay open, marked "deferred to the owner's machine ()"; the review's own runs below met every number. Checked locally (): tools/check-main.sh on clean HEAD 3b0812a (the review's code changes) builds , debug (ASan, UBSan), debug-gcc and wasm, and every test passes; its full lint was stopped by the owner's change, but tools/private-build.sh --lint over the same files was clean (clang-tidy, ast-grep, no call cycle in 176 files). The dashboard is regenerated at 3b0812a.

item.p: Numbers (release; run-qt4.sh XP40 and XQ40, run-xslt.sh, run-xsd.sh; every test set finished, 0 crashes, no leak reported by the drivers' budgets, 0 "error" outcomes in all four suites), at 02303a7 and unchanged at 3b0812a, all 150,228 outcomes case by case: XSD in scope 41,483 of 41,518, 99.9 % (gate 90 %; the 41,538 of became 41,518 with 's per-element scope); datatypes 30,598 of 30,598, 100 % (gate 95 %), structures 8,600 of 8,626, 99.7 % (gate 80 %), XSD 1.1 2,285 of 2,294, 99.6 % (gate 70 %). Schema-aware XQ40 1,236 of 1,516, 81.5 % (gate 70 %; XP40's 279 of 315, 88.6 %); schema-aware XT40 627 of 971, 64.6 % (gate 60 %). XP40 in scope 30,783 of 31,543, 97.6 % (gate 90 %), XQ40 40,315 of 41,174, 97.9 % (85 %), XT40 8,029 of 8,728, 92.0 % (70 %), passed counts 30,931, 41,273 and 8,650, none lower than at the Phase 4 gate (30,647, 40,034, 7,990); the 12 core sets 88.5 % (mode) to 100 %. Slices: qt4/slice 198, qt4/xquery-slice 186, xslt/slice 147, xsd slice 147 (ctest, every preset).

Fuzzing, 300 s per target, eight at once on four cores (fork mode for the evaluating targets): cast_fuzz 1,790,230 runs, regex_fuzz 656,221, xml_parse_fuzz 79,380, xpath_compile_fuzz 10,229, xpath_evaluate_fuzz about 8,300, xquery_fuzz about 9,300, xslt_fuzz about 10,500, schema_fuzz about 11,700; no crash, leak or sanitizer report. Timeouts for triage only (P9): one xquery_fuzz and three xslt_fuzz inputs, all suite texts slow by nature under ASan (a FLWOR over 200,001 maps, nested counts to 1,000, match="$nodeset" over 1,000 nodes), 8 to 12 s alone. schema_fuzz (tests/fuzz/schema_fuzz.c, new): the input is a schema document, a zero byte and an instance; the schema is compiled from text with a resolver that serves nothing, and the instance validated strictly while parsed and laxly by sxml_schema_validate_node; seeds are the first schema document of each test group of the XSD suite, alone and with each instance of the group (tools/fuzz-seeds.py).

The step budgets are fair test limits, not masks. QT4's 4 x 10^8 per evaluation () and XSLT's (, judged by ) apply to the test drivers only, below the library's default of 10^9 (). app-Demos itunes is quadratic by its own text: local:tracks-by-artist filters all 6,597 tracks once per artist, three times per artist (one-hit-wonder, years-by-artist, the title), and each find-key-string scans a track's keys; 287 million steps by 's accounting, 72 s (release, this machine). Sampled stacks are flat (filters, atomization, general comparisons, the axis iterator), with no schema code among them: the schema-element() tests resolve statically to element tests (), so validation costs nothing per step. What it shows is a general evaluator item, a join that a processor with an index on $seq[f(.) = $key] would do in linear time, and about 4 million steps a second; listed, not a Phase 5 defect.

No driver reclassifies outcomes: the QT4 driver's only rule left is 's, for test cases outside scope that stop at a missing non-goal (never for schema-aware ones, ); the XSLT driver counts SXML_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE as "fail" and judges an invalid source by the assertions (). The XSD driver still made a validation that meets SXML_STATUS_UNSUPPORTED_FEATURE "not run" ('s rule from before 5.8 and 5.9): now "fail", reason "instance: unsupported feature", as the XSLT driver does. No test reached it (no schema code returns the status), so no number moves.

: no call cycle (tools/check-call-cycles.py). Component graphs (type derivation chains, group and attribute group references, substitution groups, union members, redefine and override chains), content models (the particle tree, nested all groups, the restriction walk) and identity constraint tables are explicit work lists or stacks with a mark per component; schema finalization releases arenas and the compiled XPath units without calling back into the schema, since the processor keeps schemas that queries and stylesheets import ('s avoided cycle). Through function pointers: the validator and the assertion copy are tree builder filters that pass events on and never call their source; an assertion, type alternative or identity constraint runs the evaluator on a dynamic context of its own, nested once at most, because their static contexts have no in-scope schemas (no validate, fn:xsd-validator refuses schemas beyond the in-scope ones) and their resolver serves nothing.

sxml_xml_text_is_ncname, sxml_xml_text_is_whitespace and sxml_xml_text_next_token (src/xml_internal.h) replace private copies: NCName checks in seven files (schema reader, cast's QName lexical form with its own copy of the name character table, xslt_read's ASCII approximation, which let any non-ASCII byte through, the XSLT lowering, fn:element-to-map, fn:id and fn:path, format-date's calendars), whitespace-only text in seven (schema reader and validator, deep-equal, serialization, XQuery's boundary whitespace, XSLT output and reading), token splitting in two; schema's views_equal (two), sxml_trim and sxml_text_is are sxml_byte_view_equals and sxml_xml_text_trim_whitespace; the content model's heapsort of keys is sxml_sort_in_place. sxml.wasm 1,997,773 bytes (was 1,998,723).

tests/schema_validate_test.c has an allocation-failure loop over compilation (with an assertion, a key and a type alternative), validation while parsing and sxml_schema_validate_node, with leak checks: the last part of 's rule schema.h lacked.

Larger duplicates, listed (one shared mechanism each, later): the reader's own lexical parsers for xs:boolean and xs:nonNegativeInteger next to the cast engine's (and XSLT's yes/no reader); Gregorian day arithmetic in four places (cast_facet.c's reference dateTimes for duration order, format_date.c, processor.c's clock, operator_temporal.c's cycle days, which is XSD Part 2, appendix E too); compile reports that append a subject to their description built in three ways (reader and resolver through xml_buffer, the content model through report_text); bounded text writers for the text forms in four files (ir.c, xslt_ast.c, schema_text.c, schema_content_model.c); three private heapsorts in serialization (serialize.c, serialize_json.c, serialize_xml.c). 's list stands (typed array allocation, group-adjacent keys, run detectors).

Delayed features (), one place each: XSLT's schema roles and typed="~ItemType" read nowhere (one unnamed role); is-id of union and list elements (); fn:xsd-validator's schema options refused in call_xsd_validator with its error. No rejection of Phase 5's features is left in the language layers.

sxml validate matches docs/CLI.md: every example of the page gives its output and exit code; the usage errors (no --schema, no FILE, a bad --mode, - twice) exit 2, a missing SCHEMA or FILE 3, a schema error and a FILE that is not well-formed 1. README is being reorganized and was left alone; its "still provisional" for schema.h is out of date after this record.

schema.h is stable ('s rule): consistent with xpath.h, xquery.h and xslt.h (quintets, configuration structs, error records, report sinks), every declaration documented, every function tested through the public API, now with an allocation-failure loop, and sxml validate on it alone. From now on it changes as every public header does ().

Proposed, resolved here: the five items whose design was accepted or that need no owner (match="$var" membership, dynamic errors in included modules, package versions for host resolvers, the XSLT functions at run time, globals computed on first read) are accepted as designs for a later sweep and leave Proposed; they are listed in the LOG. Left for the owner: the WebAssembly budgets (four items; sxml.wasm is 1,997,773 of 2,000,000 bytes stripped and 695,343 of 700,000 gzipped, the CLI 4,950,289 of 5,500,000 and 1,154,545 of 1,250,000) and XQuery's omit-xml-declaration default.

Not done (listed in the LOG): is-id of union and list elements; XSLT's ID/IDREF checks for elements as well as documents, schema roles, xs:untypedAtomic as a type, xml:lang declarations (); the XSD failures lists (XSD 1.0 rules XSD 1.1 changed, NOTATION union members, XML 1.1 instances, Element Declarations Consistent with wildcards).
